stage: Isolated regular Radial numeric research candidate; no production admission
nativeModel: Separately labeled Python GPU GLSL frontend/native Metal compiler, unchanged pinned native Radial function arithmetic with explicit ABI aliases, direct RGBA32F. Not EEVEE material/film.

inputs.representation: Exact uint32 Float32 input words, no JSON float transport or implicit UV field
inputs.specialControls: All signed-zero origins and tiny sector-neighbor values remain research controls; they do not grant subnormal or seam support.

diagnosticGates.branch: For non-origin inputs, segment index reconstructed from native width and rotation must agree exactly. Any seam branch disagreement fails, independently of coordinate tolerance. Origin phase is explicitly overridden by native code, so its auxiliary rotation is recorded without granting extra output support.
diagnosticGates.origin: Projected phase and radius controls exact; no output repair.

boundBasis: Predeclared pinned-profile test budgets, not portable hardware error theorems. Radius8ULP/2^-20 allows rounded multiply/add/sqrt and source FMA choices on bounded coordinates. Regular phase derivative w.r.t. angle is1 raw and N/(2PI)<=1.91 normalized;2^-18 tests a few F32 trig/arithmetic ULP through this bounded branch. It does not cover WGSL's much looser portable atan2 allowance, and cannot excuse discontinuous sector selection. Width retains the existing2ULP/2^-22 source-constant budget. No observed failure will widen these gates in this batch.
portableSpecificationLimit: WGSL atan2 f32 permits4096ULP for normal inputs; see https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-WGSL-20260703/#accuracy-of-concrete-floating-point-expressions. Signed zeros/subnormals and branch cuts require separate controls.
